jobs_results.title: Supplier Lifecycle & Risk Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Job Title: Supplier Lifecycle & Risk Management Project Manager

City, Country: Barcelona, Spain or Global

Hybrid/Remote/On Site/: Hybrid

As a Supplier Lifecycle & Risk Management Project Manager, your will be a key player in the Procurement Excellence organization. The role will contribute to the delivery of the S2P Roadmap; to the implementation of Supplier Lifecycle Management processes and Risk Management framework for raw materials and suppliers.

At dsm-firmenich, being a force for good is not optional. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is a shared responsibility woven into our daily work to not only benefit our People, Customers & Communities but also drive business value. Equal access to opportunities is a given, belonging is a shared feeling, authenticity is celebrated.

Your key responsibilities
• Support the implementation of supplier lifecycle processes, incl. supplier qualification and onboarding, supplier segmentation and relationship management, supplier performance and... risk management;
• Implement the Procurement risk management framework for suppliers and raw materials (incl. strategy, tools and processes);
• Coordinate raw material de-risking strategy and program execution;
• For procurement-owned data, support with the definition and manage master data governance and operating model;
• Use innovative approaches to rationalize raw material & supplier bases, to identify synergy opportunities/quick wins and improve process efficiency.
• Foster optimal governance and communication with the stakeholders.

We bring
• Empowerment to make meaningful contributions while upholding ethical standards.
• Recognition and celebration of your efforts and accomplishments.
• Opportunities for growth and advancement for those who embrace innovation and take initiative.
• Collaboration with experts in health, nutrition, and beauty to drive progress.
• Customer-first approach, working with world-renowned brands to turn ideas into impactful solutions.
• Opportunity to build a career making a significant impact on billions of lives, with the freedom to shape your own path

You bring
• Min. 5 years of procurement expertise.
• Min. 5 years of experience in dealing with global complex stakeholders and change management.
• Strategic thinking, solution-oriented with excellent analytical, planning and organizing skills.
• Effective interpersonal, communication and active listening skills.
• Fluent written and spoken English.

Our application process

Interested in this position? Please apply on-line by uploading your resume in English via our career portal. For further information, please contact Mimi Phommachak, Recruiter (mimi.phommachak@dsm-firmenich.com )

#LI-DNI

jobs_results.title: JUNIOR PROJECT MANAGER CAPEX
jobs_results.description:
ROLE: JUNIOR PROJECT MANAGER CAPEX

Daily tasks:
• Project management of CAPEX projects up to 1 m€ (civil works, mechanical, piping, electrical, control & automation)
• Scoping, estimation, risk assessment, coordination and planning with different departments for its implementation
• Implementation of projects considering Safety First
• Initiate MOC workflow and close out after completion
• Evaluate and mitigate/removal risks (Risk Management)
• Supervision of contractor activities on site regarding PRL. Ensure Safety rules accomplishment.
• Actively involved in the project design and propose project & process improvements
• Final project documentation
• Handover & Aftercare
• Project Cost control
• Project progress reporting (safety, financials, planning, risks).

Experience required:
• Around 5 years of experience involved in engineering project management in chemical, food or pharma manufacturing environment (civil works, mechanical, piping, electrical, control & automation)
•... Industrial or Chemical Engineering background
• Experience in installation, erection or/and revamping of installations as project engineer, and project manager. Experience also in construction management is a plus for the position
• Accustomed to follow-up projects at field and precommissioning
• Support to RTO for commissioning and its start-up
• Accustomed to stablish relationships with suppliers of machinery and contractors (civil works, mechanical, piping, electrical, control & automation)
• Autocad user level and 3D autoplant user level
• SAP knowledge as user level is a plus for the position
• Good command of English (First certificate level)
• Skills to plan, organize and establish priorities, Excellent communication skills, proactive and autonomous behavior.
• Experience in plant revamping is a plus for the position
• Experience in GMP validation processes is a plus for the position

Location: Montmeló, Barcelona

Contract: Undetermined contract

Modality: Presencial, 1 day of home office

jobs_results.title: Principal Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Join our global team dedicated to innovation and initiative, where physical walls and different time zones don’t limit, but encourage, collaboration. Where all contributions and new ideas are explored with an open mind and work is driven by our shared values: be courageous, be accountable, be honest, be inclusive and elevate others.

Job Description Summary

Job Description
ROLE

As Principal Project Manager, Biometrics you will hold a combined technical and leadership position within our global Project Management department. You will lead Biometrics projects from inception to completion, managing and deploying resources effectively, and work alongside the Director of Project Management to maintain effective departments that are focused on delivering the highest quality of outputs and customer care.

KEY RESPONSABILITIES
• Planning and oversight of the projects, from inception to completion, ensuring completion on time, within cost and required quality standards.
• Coaching and... mentoring Senior/Junior Project Managers and supports Project Manager Director with process improvement initiatives.
• Timely oversight of the budget, including work completed, hours used and profit status and ensure the profitability target is met.
• Support in reviewing budget proposals and bid defense meeting.

DESIRED QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE
• Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline or college diploma
• At least 5 years of experience in Clinical Research environment
• Previous experience in Biometrics (Data Management, Statistics, Statistical Programming) At least 3 years of experience in Project management roles

Languages
English

Education
Bachelor of Science (BS): Life Sciences

jobs_results.title: Engineering Project Manager - Sestao (M/F)
jobs_results.description: Context: In our Sestao plant and within the engineering division, we are looking for Project Managers in anticipation of major upcoming projects. These roles can be open to 2-3 years mobilities. Your role: As part of new investments, relining or improvement operations, you lead projects on mechanical or electrical installations (including the preliminary project study, investment file, realization and commissioning). In the pre-project phase and from the study request, you lead the search for optimal technical solutions are involved in putting together the related investment file. During the study phase, you manage internal and external studies of the projects entrusted to dedicated companies and ensure their compliance with current regulations. In conjunction with the purchasing department, you are involved in the choice of original equipment manufacturers and needed suppliers. During the execution phase you are responsible for planning and resources management, ensuring compliance... with health and safety directives is met by all involved personal. Finally, in the commissioning phase, you support the operational teams and ensure that operations run smoothly. Your profile : From an engineering background, your high technical skills on mechanical or electrical topics make you an expert in one of these fields. You have several years of experience (at least 5) in CAPEX projects management within ArcelorMittal and have excellent technical knowledge and solid notions of project management methodology (CIPM) Your autonomy, decision-making capacity and resistance to stress linked to project challenges make you a strong candidate for this position. A very good level of professional English is required Knowledge of professional and technical Spanish is an asset

jobs_results.title: Project Manager, Imaging
jobs_results.description:
At ICON, it’s our people that set us apart. Our diverse teams enable us to become a better partner to our customers and help us to fulfil our mission to advance and improve patients’ lives.

Our ‘Own It’ culture is driven by four key values that bring us together as individuals and set us apart as an organisation: Accountability & Delivery, Collaboration, Partnership and Integrity. We want to be the Clinical Research Organisation that delivers excellence to our clients and to patients at every touch-point. In short, to be the partner of choice in drug development.

That’s our vision. We’re driven by it. And we need talented people who share it.
If you’re as driven as we are, join us. You’ll be working in a dynamic and supportive environment, with some of the brightest and the friendliest people in the sector, and you’ll be helping shape an industry.

The role:

Apply project management principles, concepts and techniques for effective project management, including quality assurance... and customer satisfaction

• Maintain a positive, results-oriented work environment by building partnerships, modeling teamwork and communicating in an open, balanced and objective manner

• Act as the primary contact and study lead with the customer from startup through close-out of a project with minimal supervision and oversight

• Develop and implement project plans and timelines via internal and external kick-off meetings and ensure agreement by parties involved, with minimal supervision

• Develop presentations for Investigator Meetings and Kick-Off Meetings and travel independently to present at these meetings when required

• Escalate issues to management as appropriate

• Complete revenue forecasting, tracking and submittal

• Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure efficient processing of project requirements, with minimal support

• Conduct routine customer teleconferences and generate and maintain accurate records and meeting minutes and agendas in

accordance with regulatory guidelines

• Update budgets and contracts and gain management approvals for Change Requests

• Generate and maintain Patient and Site Tracking Reports via MS Excel and study databases and provide updates to customers on a

regular basis

• Coordinate with internal teams to query sites to submit incoming data and resolve data issues

• Travel with Business Development for customer meetings

• Present internally and externally on project portfolio

• Identify potential risks to projects and implement processes and tactics to proactively mitigate

• Compliance with internal SOPs

• Participate in developing and updating internal documents and guides (e.g. training materials, SOPs, etc.)

• Participate, as requested by Regulatory Affairs, in customer audits of BioTelemetry Research

• Participate in training and mentoring of Project Manager Is and newly-hired Project Manager IIs

• Provide oversight of Site Management activities for assigned projects

• Participate in interview process, including shadowing by potential employees

• Potentially act as Lead Project Manager on assigned projects

• Meet or exceed internal Project Management metrics

• Continue professional development and education

• Travel possibly required up to 20% of the time

Benefits of Working in ICON:
Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

We offer very competitive salary packages. And to keep them competitive, we regularly benchmark them against our competitors. Our annual bonuses reflect delivery of performance goals - both ours and yours.
We also provide a range of health-related benefits to employees and their families and offer competitive retirement plans - and related benefits such as life assurance - so you can save and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
But beyond the competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits, you’ll benefit from an environment where you are encouraged to fulfil your sense of purpose and drive lasting change.

ICON is an equal opportunity and inclusive employer and is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know through the form below.

#LI-SB5

jobs_results.title: Project manager m/f/d
jobs_results.description:
Join our high-tech team!
Kappa optronics develops and manufactures innovative cameras for international customers in target industries such as aviation, defense and automotive. Cameras and vision systems for everything that drives and flies - here we are amongst the best in the world.Your Responsibilities:
• Management of complex, technical, customer-specific and international development projects (hardware, software, mechanics, system integration)
• Leading agile project teams
• Carrying out the feasibility analysis, requirements management and risk analysis and thus ensuring the project's ability to be implemented
• Managing development projects in terms of quality, costs and deadlines, coordinating all project team members involved and ensuring development goals are met
• Preparing project planning, identifying deviations from and conflicts with objectives and initiating appropriate measures to resolve them
• Implementing activities and projects in accordance with agile project... management standards and customer-specific specifications and norms

Your Qualifications:
• Successfully completed studies (project management, commercial or technical studies) or comparable qualification (e.g. relevant training)
• Professional experience in project management desirable
• Good technical understanding
• Experience in agile methods in the development of complex systems is a plus
• Good self-organization and time management skills
• Structured, goal- and result-oriented way of working
• Moderation skills, strong negotiation skills, conflict resolution and communication skills
• Good written and spoken German and English skills
• Willingness for occasional international travel
• High willingness to learn and self-interest in integration into the team

What we offer:
• Leading projects in globally challenging markets
• Highly effective and communicative agile teams
• Many clear perspectives for further professional development
• Very short and fast decision-making channels, direct access to all relevant functions and stakeholders
• A highly motivated team and a family style of work
• Job-related educational programs
• Bike leasing, English lessons, company pension plan, etc.
• Flexible work environment and working hours
• Home office opportunities
• 30 days annual leave

jobs_results.title: Manufacturing & Supply Project manager
jobs_results.description:
A leading entity in the paints and coatings industry, renowned for its innovative products and commitment to sustainability, is seeking a Manufacturing & Supply Project Manager to join their team, based in Barcelona. This position plays a crucial role in managing the Make/Supply Planning transformation program within the Business Unit for Europe, driving the transition from current to newly designed planning processes, and developing regional planning team capabilities.

Responsibilities:
• Lead the transformation and continuous assessment of the supply chain to identify business improvement opportunities, including end-to-end value stream mapping.
• Analyze and define business improvements and projects to optimize supply chain performance in terms of On-Time In-Full (OTIF), Cost to Serve, and Working Capital across the EMEA Region.
• Develop customer service offers and translate them into replenishment models, optimizing the usage of the distribution network and enhancing... interactions between customer service and planning, including e-commerce strategies and logistics optimization.
• Support the delivery of regional supply chain KPIs and ensure collaborative partnerships with key stakeholders.
• Manage project scopes and timelines to ensure high-quality deliverables.

Qualifications:
• University degree with a minimum of 6 years of experience in the FMCG, Paint/Coating, or Retail industries, particularly in Supply Chain Improvement or Consulting.
• A strong consulting background with extensive experience in Manufacturing Supply Planning, Integrated Business Planning (IBP) processes, and planning tools, including proficiency in SAP ECC and BI.
• Demonstrated ability in change management and stakeholder engagement, with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
• Resilient and adaptable with a problem-solving attitude and project management expertise.
• Fluency in English is mandatory.

The ideal candidate will be recognized for their credibility, openness to new ideas, result-oriented approach, and excellent problem-solving capabilities. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to significant business improvements and work within a diverse and inclusive environment committed to professional growth and development.

Are you interested? We would love to meet you!

Uno de nuestros objetivos como organización es asegurar un proceso de selección alineado con criterios de diversidad , equidad e inclusión por ello buscamos crear un panel de empleados diverso, equitativo e inclusivo, donde cada individuo sea valorado por su talento y potencial, sin importar su origen étnico, género, orientación sexual, religión o diversidad funcional.

Nos comprometemos a minimizar cualquier sesgo o barrera que pueda existir en el proceso de selección, para asegurar que todos los candidatos sean evaluados de manera justa y objetiva donde solo sea evaluado su capacidad para realizar la función, su potencial y su valores

Uno de nuestros objetivos como organización es asegurar un proceso de selección alineado con criterios de diversidad , equidad e inclusión por ello buscamos crear un panel de empleados diverso, equitativo e inclusivo, donde cada individuo sea valorado por su talento y potencial, sin importar su origen étnico, género, orientación sexual, religión o diversidad funcional.

Nos comprometemos a minimizar cualquier sesgo o barrera que pueda existir en el proceso de selección, para asegurar que todos los candidatos sean evaluados de manera justa y objetiva donde solo sea evaluado su capacidad para realizar la función, su potencial y su valores

jobs_results.company_name: Radisson Hotel Group, Madrid Office-Information Technology
jobs_results.description:
The Radisson
Hotel Group, one of the most dynamic hotel companies in the world, is looking
for a talented Project Manager to join the
Creative Service Desk team, the company’s internal creative department and will
be based in Radisson Hotel Group in Madrid, Spain.

Creative Service Desk (CSD) acts as RHG Guardian for all RHG
brands and stakeholders at a global level. Being part of Global Brand &
Guest Experience Department, CSD is responsible to liaise with all stakeholders
at a corporate, regional and local hotel levels to ensure all online/offline
presence of RHG is in line with our brand DNA as well as ensure that all brand
guidelines are implemented in the most agile and innovate way. As a new
established global team, CSD is developing its ways of working for EMEA and
APAC.

The CSD Project Manager will act as the point of contact of CSD in Madrid,
liaising with all stakeholders (corporate, regional, hotels) to ensure all
projects are developed through RHG certified agencies as... well as contribute to
the promotion of our brands through innovative and high quality campaigns and
assets.

Key Roles and Responsibilities:

· Be the primary point of
contact of CSD and build long-term relationship with stakeholders (corporate,
regional, hotels)

· Support stakeholders
(marketing, branding, commercial, operations, sales, business development, HR,
internal comms, PR teams) with online/offline creative/adaptation content for
B2B, B2C campaigns, collaterals development, video content, photography and
liaison with production partner and creative agencies

· Develop her/his role as the
trusted brand advisor for RHG internal stakeholders while nurturing the
relationship with the external certified vendors (pool of agencies)

· Ensure the timely and
successful delivery of projects according to each stakeholder needs and
objectives

· Ensure alignment and knowledge
sharing with the CSD EMEA to ensure efficiency and project optimization

· Ensure that stakeholders are aligned to the new
Ways of Working re projects’ development through outsourcing to RHG certified
agencies (global, regional, local level)

Skills and requirements:

· At
least 4 years of marketing, project management experience with agency
background desirable

· Excellent
planning and coordinating skills

· Proven
project management experience preferable in the hospitality industry

· Demonstrated
ability to communicate, present and influence credibly and effectively at all
levels of the organisation

· Experience
in delivering client-focused solutions

· Multi-tasking
ability while paying attention to details (technical and brand guidelines)

· Excellent
verbal and written skills in EN

· Solid
digital understanding

· Self-motivated
and able to thrive in a results-driven environment

· Natural
relationship builder with integrity, reliability and maturity

· Ability
to prioritize among competing tasks

· Critical
thinking and problem-solving skills

· Understanding
of brands and their importance

Requirements and Qualifications:

· Bachelor's Degree in Hospitality or Graphic Design

· Minimum 4 years working in a creative agency or media marketing within the hospitality industry

· Excellent written and verbal knowledge of English

#LI-DM1

Compensation: To be discussed

jobs_results.title: (Senior) Project Manager in Consulting for Strategic Procurement ...
jobs_results.description:
Introduction

We are one of the top names for strategic procurement and supply chain management. As an independent subsidiary of BCG, we offer the best of both worlds: in-depth expertise and high strategic competence and we are able to draw on a strong, international infrastructure, which makes us even more dynamic in the market.

That’s why we want to strengthen our team. With someone that matches our ambitions as well as our spirit. So that we remain not only very successful, but also very INVERTO.

Join our 2023 newly opened office in Madrid from September onwards and be part of another successful growth story!

VERY EXCITING FOR YOU.

Holistic project management.

You will be responsible for the development and successful implementation of suitable strategies to optimize the supply chain and strategic procurement process. You will demonstrate your entrepreneurial talent in project controlling and in the acquisition of new customers.

Broad range of challenges.

Broad customer... portfolios and project assignments at home and abroad for a wide variety of industries and customers. From start-ups, retail, and consumer goods, to the energy and automotive industries or the pharmaceutical and healthcare sectors.

Intensive customer consulting.

You will work closely with customers, be their main contact person and be responsible for conducting your team's workshops, negotiations and presentations.

Specific development.

Your professional expertise will help to drive forward the development of knowledge in our company.

Far-reaching responsibility.

You will ensure that your team develops both professionally and personally. As a member of the INVERTO management team, you can help shape the development of our entire company and give it the necessary impetus.

VERY IMPORTANT FOR US.

University degree with above-average grades and 4-8 years of relevant professional experience.

Extensive expertise in consulting, ideally in procurement / supply chain management and a passion for strategic and operational work.

You have already proven your analytical and conceptual skills at management level in demanding projects. You show full commitment, are customer-oriented and cooperative. You have shown that you can successfully lead teams professionally and personally.

Very INVERTO: Team player. Both feet firmly on the ground. Fair. Fun.

Confident appearance in an international environment, business fluent in English and Spanish, flexible in your professional mobility.

VERY BENEFIT.

Regular team evenings, a multi-day annual conference, employee and sport events.

Professional career development.

Support of your academic further training.

If needed: a longer timeout.

Comprehensive insurance package.

A company car that you can also use privately.

Employee referral programs.

Child- & eldercare, coaching.

Interested?

Please apply online via the INVERTO applicant portal. Ms Simone Mavero is available to answer your questions by calling +39 0289 743 045 or sending an e-mail to karriere@inverto.com

INVERTO GmbH
